other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage across cross-validation folds
other_failure_modes.description: Unsupervised transformations (like TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD) and group aggregations (frequency counts, means) are fitted on the entire training dataset before cross-validation. This leaks information about the validation folds into the training folds, leading to overly optimistic out-of-fold performance estimates.
other_failure_modes.evidence: trn_tfidf_mat = vec.fit_transform(trn_raw) [...] company_counts = train_df["Company"].value_counts().to_dict() [...] applied prior to the 'for fold in range(n_splits):' loop.

summary: The agent developed a very sophisticated and robust pipeline involving deep feature engineering, multiple gradient boosted trees, a PyTorch Tabular ResNet, and meta-learner stacking. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the dataset by using a random StratifiedKFold, which causes look-ahead bias. Additionally, global dataset statistics and text transformations are fitted on the full training set prior to CV splitting, causing moderate data leakage across folds.
